en-US.name: My Agent
en-US.summary: Voice bridge to a personal OpenClaw agent running Claude.
en-US.description: Talks to a self-hosted OpenClaw agent (running Claude) through a personal HTTPS bridge you run yourself. Personal-use skill, kept in development mode — not distributed through the public skill store.
examplePhrases: Alexa, ask my agent to check my calendar
Alexa, ask my agent what's on my schedule

publishingInformation.testingInstructions: Personal-use skill backed by a self-hosted bridge (see repo README). No public testing account exists.
